title: PREDICT genetic carrier test pilot screening rates and outreach
asked: Dr Choo Pei Ling asked why screening uptake was low against the target of 40,000 married couples between 2024 and 2027, with 674 screened at end-2025, and whether couples planning to marry, such as those on the HDB Fiancé/Fiancée Scheme, could be included.
response: Mr Ong Ye Kung said PREDICT is a pilot for prenatal screening of carriers of recessive genetic disorders, offered to almost all couples KKH attends to, but fewer than 1,300 showed interest and about 800 have gone through tests. He said many did not complete mandatory genetic counselling or decided not to proceed after it, and the earlier target was too ambitious. He said MOH will review the target and pilot with KKH and Temasek Foundation, and will study how to implement PREDICT better.

key_points.point: PREDICT is a pilot project to enhance prenatal screening of carriers of recessive genetic disorders.
key_points.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
key_points.quote: a pilot project to enhance prenatal screening of carriers of recessive genetic disorders

key_points.point: It is offered to almost all couples KKH is attending to, but fewer than 1,300 couples showed interest in participating.
key_points.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
key_points.quote: fewer than 1,300 couples showed interest and wish to participate in the pilot programme

key_points.point: Many couples did not complete the mandatory genetic counselling or decided not to proceed after it.
key_points.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
key_points.quote: Many couples did not complete the mandatory genetic counselling or decide not to proceed after the genetic counselling.

key_points.point: About 800 couples have gone through the tests.
key_points.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
key_points.quote: today, about 800 couples have gone through the tests

key_points.point: The earlier target was too ambitious, and the target and pilot will be reviewed with KKH and Temasek Foundation.
key_points.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
key_points.quote: The earlier target set was obviously too ambitious, and we will review both the target and the pilot with KKH and Temasek Foundation

key_points.point: A key reason is that PREDICT is a preconception test, while KKH mainly comes into contact with pregnant couples.
key_points.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
key_points.quote: Because this is a preconception test, KKH does not really come into contact with preconception couples.

key_points.point: The only contact points are fertility clinics and IVF clinics, where couples mainly want to get pregnant.
key_points.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
key_points.quote: the only contact points they have are the fertility clinics and in-vitro fertilisation (IVF) clinics

key_points.point: A suspected reason is insurance: couples ask what happens if they test positive for a genetic condition.
key_points.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
key_points.quote: Then what happens to my insurance?

key_points.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
key_points.quote: PREDICT covers just too many diseases, 80 diseases.

key_points.point: A new Act is being drafted so that genetic data cannot be used for insurance underwriting.
key_points.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
key_points.quote: we are in the process of drafting a new Act that will come to this Chamber to approve – so that genetic data cannot be used for insurance underwriting.

key_points.point: A disease-specific approach, like FH or breast cancer, is more likely to be successful.
key_points.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
key_points.quote: we think it is more likely to be successful if you take a disease-specific approach, like FH or breast cancer

key_points.point: MOH will study how to implement PREDICT better.
key_points.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
key_points.quote: We will study how to implement this better because I think there is great potential for us to improve this.

left_open: Whether couples planning to get married, such as those on the HDB Fiancé/Fiancée Scheme, could be included in PREDICT
Whether earlier touchpoints such as Registry of Marriage or Registry of Muslim Marriages applications could be more effective
What role incentives could play in improving uptake
supplementary: Supplementary questions focused on reasons for low uptake, earlier outreach touchpoints, and possible incentives.
